description: Writes a business template's places and people. "save" creates (no id) or changes (given fields only) a site, resource or professional (staff); "remove" deletes one, refused while a coming session or service uses it; "close" closes one or, with no kind, the whole business for some days: its sessions not started are cancelled and clients refunded at once, no approval; "reopen" lifts it. "note" records what the business owes someone (no money moves); "userNote" a private note on a client; "approve" an application creates its site and team group and invites the applicant, "reject" lets them apply again; "rateUser" rates a client; "hideReview"; "addSeller", "removeSeller", "sellerLink" (the seller's Stripe onboarding). Reads: neblla_business_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/business

action.description: What to do. By action: save {kind, id?, …fields}; remove {kind, id}; note {who, amount, date?, note?}; close {kind?, id?, from, to?, reason?, timeZone?}; reopen {closure}; approve {application}; reject {application, reason?}

amount.description: note: cents the business owes them, negative when paid; only a record.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

capacity.description: save (resources): how many fit in one.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

fields.description: save: answers to the app's own questions.

hidden.description: hideReview: false shows the review again.

hours.description: save / close: opening hours { timeZone?, week: { MO: ["09:00-14:00"] }, closed?: [dates] }.

id.description: save / remove: the item's id; left out in save, makes a new one.

kind.description: save / remove / close: sites, resources or staff; close without it closes the whole business.

reason.description: close / reject: what clients read, e.g. "Public holiday".

site.description: save: the site a resource belongs to.

sites.description: save (staff): the site ids where they work.

slot.description: rateUser: the session they were in.

timeZone.description: save / close: an IANA time zone.

user.description: userNote / rateUser: the user's id in the app.
